item.title: Volunteer search for missing Tasmanian finds 'human remains'
item.description: A volunteer search team looking for missing George Town man Michael Vrankovic in northern Tasmania discovers what are believed to be human remains. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Liberal bus crashes into shop awning on its first outing of Victorian election campaign
item.description: Opposition leader Jess Wilson grimaces as the ‘Jess Express’, carrying Liberals and reporters, backs into the structure in suburban Melbourne Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Victorian Liberal party’s first offical day on the campaign trail has hit a snag, after its campaign bus reversed into the awning of a shopfront. The “Jess Express”, a large blue bus emblazoned with an image of the opposition leader, Jess Wilson, was unveiled on Friday, 12 days after Labor launched its own red equivalent. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Benita Kolovos Victorian state correspondent

item.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon trial live updates: former police officer continues evidence in double murder trial
item.description: This blog has now closed Beau Lamarre-Condon tells double murder trial shooting of Jesse Baird wasn’t intentional but ‘it was my fault’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Lamarre-Condon tells the court he had seen what he assumed to be someone’s delivery motorcycle: As soon as I saw that I had an idea … I saw a hi-vis hooded jacket, waterproof long pants and gloves. This moment here … I wish that I didn’t do this … But I had the thought process that if I was to put on this helmet and outfit I could knock on Jesse’s door I would look like an UberEats driver without… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Police offer $250k reward to find offshore crime boss
item.description: Police describe Anthony Pele as one of their highest-priority fugitives, offering $250,000 to associates willing to turn the alleged gang leader over to authorities. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: A court heard the boy held the woman's partner at knifepoint while she was raped by two other teenagers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Aussie Rules has long history of footy gimmicks gone wrong
item.description: Forget Wharfie Time. Australian Rules football has a long history of gimmicks that haven't always turned out well, and they have involved everything from a hovercraft to a Batmobile and even an elephant. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Women's pelvic health surgeon among SA's Australian of the Year winners
item.description: An endo-gynaecologist specialising in pelvic floor treatments has been named the South Australia's 2027 Australian of the Year in a ceremony where the former recipient doubled down on her wish to secure a spot on a future space mission. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Powerhouse Parramatta opens this weekend – and it’s dazzling inside and out
item.description: Coups de théâtre abound in the $915m addition to western Sydney’s skyline, which opens on Saturday with five new exhibitions – and a 23-day festival Get our weekend culture and lifestyle email Dubbed the “Opera House of western Sydney”, Powerhouse Parramatta’s white lattice exoskeleton, composed from 1,300 individual pieces and wrapping 30,000 sq metres of interior space, has already become a familiar landmark. Even better known, perhaps, is the project’s controversial history . Since the Parramatta outpost was announced in 2014, a vocal group of dissenters led by former staff and trustees… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: NT architect wins top honour, joining ranks of Sydney Opera House designer
item.description: The Alice Springs architect behind the NT's only 6-star green rated building has been awarded the industry's highest honour. The win sees Susan Dugdale join the ranks of other influential designers, including the architect behind the Sydney Opera House. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Gemma Ferguson

item.title: Researchers call for rethink on disposal of washed-up whale carcasses
item.description: Marine scientist Olaf Meynecke says disposing of dead whales is complex, costly and should not fall to local councils. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Child dies, woman in serious condition after two-car Bass Highway crash
item.description: A 10-year-old girl has died and a woman is in a serious condition in hospital after a two-car crash near Somerset in Tasmania's north-west. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Police divers and helicopters search for missing fisherman
item.description: Police from Victoria and New South Wales are searching for a man who disappeared after going fishing near the Murray River Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Brothers open Ceduna's first barber shop in 50 years
item.description: Two Eyre Peninsula brothers have opened a 100 per cent Aboriginal-owned barber shop in the main street of Ceduna, the first men's hairdresser in the town for 50 years. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Police expand operation targeting Melbourne arsons and extortion
item.description: Night-time patrols as part of Operation Phoenix will be expanded across Melbourne as police try to stem a wave of arson attacks and extortion linked to crime gangs. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Texas Farm Funds Scholarships: Donated land backs Gruver High students; many are first-generation grads
item.description: In Gruver, Texas, a remarkable farming initiative has turned inherited land into a thriving source of scholarship funds for local students. By pooling their resources, farmers and community members cultivate crops that have raised around $3 million for education since 2012, benefitting nearly 300 students, including first-generation college graduates like Sydney Ortiz and Rhett Sparks. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: WA quick Lance 'Wild Thing' Morris hopes to be even faster after surgery
item.description: After years of back issues, cricketer Lance Morris is finally fit and firing, and the Western Australian is keen to put his name in the frame for a Test call up once again. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
